name: mirage
text: Built and tested, not released yet. A bid with a sharp book in its fair, and a quote read within 90 s, now steps its margin from the usual 4% down to 1.5% under that sharp fair as the game goes from 12 h to 2 h away. It is never lower than 1.5%, and the sharp veto still applies. Bids without a fresh sharp read are unchanged. Two caveats: the freshness check uses the newest quote behind the fair, not the sharp book's own timestamp. There is also no Settings switch yet; I'll add that. The code is on my branch. It reaches main and a release once the full data test suite passes.
